request.system: Assess whether the hypothesis or expression uses or tests numbered claims. Return JSON only: {"uses_claim": true|false, "claim_ids": []}. Return one bare JSON object without Markdown fences or commentary. uses_claim must be a JSON boolean. claim_ids must be an array of integer claim numbers, never quoted strings; use an empty array when uses_claim is false.
request.prompt: {"claims": {"1": "**Findings so far**", "2": "**Failure:** Ranking groups by three-month change in average hours had no predictive power.", "3": "Mean rank IC was slightly negative, with t near minus 0.7.", "4": "**Promising:** Annual hourly-pay growth, standardized against each group's own five-year history, gave IC about 0.08 with HAC t near 1.8.", "5": "Coverage was only 44 percent.", "6": "An expanding-window log-growth version raised coverage to 63 percent.", "7": "However, it weakened IC to 0.05, with t 1.4.", "8": "The pay signal is stronger when the common index is high (IC near 0.2) than when low (about 0.1).", "9": "A high-regime-only version showed IC 0.19 but no t-statistic, so it is unconfirmed.", "10": "Signals are persistent and have low correlation with base factors."}, "hypothesis": "If the V03-minus-V02 spread's predictive power comes mainly from V03, the three-month change in V03 alone should predict higher next-month relative returns, with a positive pooled rank IC.", "expression": "chg(V03,3)"}
